projects.title: OnBase Public Access
projects.description:
This project entailed importing and indexing all scanned-in Historical Administrative Codes into the OnBase document management system. Additionally, a public access version of the system was configured to allow the public to access and download these documents. 
A similar project was done that allows the public to search for filed Judicial Financial Disclosure forms: https://nvcourts.gov/AOC/FinancialDisclosures/FDSearch.aspx

GitHub: https://github.com/smiths37/NVSC_Web/blob/master/AOC/FinancialDisclosures/FDLogin.aspx.cs
https://nvcourts.gov/LawLibrary/NAC/NACSearch.aspx

projects.title: Judicial Education Online Conference Registration
projects.description: This system allowed external users to register and pay for Judicial Education conferences and seminars. It integrates with the internal Conference Management system and the electronic payment system used by the Court.
